Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[Lift Tube Escape]]: the cast of the BBC sitcom ''Are You Being Served?'' on the set of the Grace Brothers department store, between 1972 and 1975. From left: Mollie Sugden (Mrs Slocombe), Wendy Richard (Miss Brahms), Trevor Bannister (Mr Lucas), Nicholas Smith (Mr Rumbold), Larry Martyn (Mr Mash), Arthur Brough (Mr Grainger), John Inman (Mr Humphries) and Frank Thornton (Captain Peacock).

Source: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Cast_of_Are_You_Being_Served_BBC_1970s.jpg Cast of Are You Being Served BBC 1970s.jpg], English Wikipedia (382 by 261 pixels; originally from a Guardian.co.uk gallery). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260312092858/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Cast_of_Are_You_Being_Served_BBC_1970s.jpg Internet Archive], 12 March 2026.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a low-resolution copy (382 by 261 pixels) of a production photograph, © BBC, shown to identify the sitcom and the department-store setting the card's lore echoes. It is used only to identify that work beside the card on [[Jokes]], on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of it exists.
